role: The mesh key's interface (raster_meshkey.c): struct meshkey, MESHKEY_NONE, MESHKEY_EMPTY, MESHKEY_OK, meshkey_section and meshkey_band.
notes: Not vanilla code: vanilla marks a renderer dirty and rebuilds it; a rebuild whose inputs hashed the same is the same bytes, so raster.c keeps the mesh (pipe_gate --mesh-check meshes every spared pass again and compares). Renderer state only, no statics; never in the tick.
